subject: Ziggy request: update your own project I_AM for cold-boot resumption
body:
Ziggy asks you to update YOUR OWN project I_AM/IM so a cold-booted instance can resume efficiently from your perspective. If no project introduction exists, author your own first one; if local writing is unavailable, return your own draft through the established relay with that limit stated.

Capture what genuinely helps: your actual responsibilities and ownership; methodology and approval gates; proven tools versus reported/untested capabilities; required inputs and expected outputs; mailbox/handoff conventions; source-of-truth and live status paths; real pitfalls/failure lessons; and the next session's first reads, open decisions and bounded resumption step. Use dated, concise changes. Do not invent experience or claim unrun tests succeeded.

Preserve your identity and established directives. Edit only your own file; do not rewrite another owner's I_AM. Crosslink central methods instead of creating conflicting rule copies. Keep human ratings, provider grades, scoped acceptance, original files, hashes and provenance distinct. CFA Nova remains sole browser/execution controller; Nova PA coordinates priorities, owners, blockers and receipts. Honour existing Phase 0 freezes and withheld inputs.

Return path plus version or hash and a short change summary in this shared mailbox, using this conversationId and replyTo. State actual received/read inputs and access limits. Posted is not read or completed. Handle this at your existing checkpoint without interrupting current jobs. This authorizes self-documentation only: no activation, generation, spending, uploads, installs, public release or changed approval permissions. The attached request links central sources.

Correlation: PROJECT-I-AM-SELF-UPDATE-20261013

attachments.description: Full project-scoped self-documentation request, roster and boundaries.
Verified current mailbox routes, distinct contexts and historical-role exclusion.
Current production methodology and scoped review gates.
Role map; current method governs older dated notes.
Current role/access and Phase 0 limits; no withheld test content.

source: Ziggy's explicit request via Personal Nova, source thread 01a12392-6543-7410-b29a-822656fb60d4, 2026-10-13: push to the project collaborators' mailboxes to update their respective IM/I_AM from their own perspective for a cold boot; lighter orientation for Kimi, DeepSeek and Qwen because they have barely started. Self-documentation only.
